{{Quote|Most Imperials wouldn't know a song sparrow from a cloud crupa. You know all my songs, I've watched your lips move.|Twilit Hearth, to Tinian I'att Azur-Jamin|<ref name="ToT" />}}
A '''song sparrow''' was a type of [[Sparrow/Legends|sparrow]].<ref name="ToT" /> In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of "[[Tinian on Trial]]" to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> the [[Musician/Legends|singer]] [[Twilit Hearth]] claimed to [[Tinian I'att Azur-Jamin]], heiress of the manufacturing company [[I'att Armament]], that most [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]] could not distinguish a song sparrow from a [[Crupa|cloud crupa]],<ref name="ToT" /> another type of [[Bird/Legends|bird]].<ref name="AGOH">{{JournalCite|1|A Glimmer of Hope}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Song sparrows were mentioned in "[[Tinian on Trial]]," a short story written by [[Kathy Tyers]] that was published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 4|fourth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''. The issue was released in [[November]] [[1994]].<ref name="ToT" />
